# SimpleSEO (GitHub Copilot Instructions)

When the user asks to run **SimpleSEO** or `/simpleseo`:
- Follow `SKILL.md` from the root of this repository.
- Enforce Gate 1 (Hosting + Custom Domain + Google Search Console check) and Gate 2 (Sub-skill list + benefits confirmation) before editing files or submitting URLs.
- Run `scripts/simpleseo_audit.py` and complete the Final PASS/FAIL Delivery Gate before returning the final report.
